parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The search keyword. Fuzzy match is supported based on the module name.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Valid values: 0 to 200.

Default value: 100.

parameters.name: namespaceName
parameters.description: The name of the workspace to which the module belongs.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token for the next page of results.

If the total number of entries exceeds the maxResults limit, the data is truncated. You can use nextToken to query the next page of data.
